# nonnative

**Tag**: web

## 简介

Starts OS processes, in-process Ruby servers, and proxy-only services with TCP readiness checks and fault-injection proxies.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/alexfalkowski/nonnative
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/nonnative/3.48.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/nonnative
